blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Bone overlap can obscure abnormalities in chest radiographs, while scarce paired training data limit supervised bone suppression. We address this challenge with a digitally reconstructed radiograph (DRR) framework that converts chest computed tomography (CT) into paired supervision for component suppression. A novel bone segmentation algorithm enables CT decomposition into bone, non-lung soft-tissue, and lung components, which are projected separately. Their weighted combination yields synthetic radiographs with pixel-registered component images that sum exactly to the full DRR. Models trained on these data suppress bone or lung components by predicting the target component and recovering the remainder by subtraction, transferring to real radiographs without real paired training data. As an extension, their outputs on real radiographs provide target domains for unpaired, component-wise DRR translation, reducing the appearance gap while retaining anatomical details. Across multiple public datasets, downstream detection experiments demonstrate the utility of bone suppression, with gains concentrated on abnormalities with substantial bone overlap. Compared with open-source DRR engines applied to the same CTs, our unmodified DRRs achieve comparable realism and preservation of label-relevant anatomy, while translated DRRs achieve the best Fréchet inception distance (FID), lung-field sharpness, and agreement with source-CT anatomy among the evaluated methods. Models and inference code: huggingface.co/qureaiorg/bone-suppression ; translated projections: huggingface.co/datasets/qureaiorg/ct2xr-projections .
blocks.zh: 骨架重叠可以遮掩胸腔放射图中的异常现象,而稀缺的配对训练数据限制了监督的骨架压制. 我们以数字重建的射电图框架来应对这一挑战,这种框架将胸部计算成的成像图(CT)转换成用于抑制组件的配对监督。 新颖的骨分化算法可以使CT分解为骨,非龙的软质组织,以及肺的元件,这些元件分别预测. 它们的加权组合产生合成射电图,其像素注册的组件图像与完整的减少灾害风险完全一致。 有关这些数据的模型通过预测目标成分和通过减法恢复其余部分,在没有真正的对等训练数据的情况下向真正的射电图转移来抑制骨骼或肺部成分. 作为一种扩展,它们在真射线图上的输出为未发酵的,基于组件的 DRR 翻译提供了目标域,在保留解剖细节的同时缩小了外观差距. 在多个公共数据集中,下游检测实验显示,抑制骨骼是有用的,收益集中于有较大骨骼重叠的异常现象。 与应用于同一CT的开源DRR引擎相比,我们未经修改的DRR实现了可比较的现实主义,并保留了与标签相关的解剖学,而翻译的DRR则实现了最佳的Fréchet初始距离(FID),肺场锐度,以及评价方法中与源-CT解剖学的一致. 模型和推论代码:拥抱面.co/qureaiorg/bone-suppried;翻译预测:拥抱面.co/datasets/qureaiorg/ct2xr-projections.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Chest radiography is among the most frequently performed diagnostic imaging examinations, but its projective nature limits what it can show: ribs, clavicles, scapulae, pulmonary vasculature, mediastinum, and chest wall are superimposed onto a single two-dimensional plane. Findings that lie behind dense structures compete with them for contrast, and pulmonary nodules and early lung cancers are frequently missed where ribs or clavicles overlap them. Suppressing bones in the image has been shown to improve nodule detection for human readers and computer-aided detection systems alike ( Li et al., 2011 ; Schalekamp et al., 2013 ; Bae et al., 2022 ; Frenkel et al., 2025 ) , and bone suppression, i.e, removing ribs and clavicles while preserving pathology, is an established processing step for chest radiographs.
blocks.zh: 胸射线学是最经常进行的诊断成像检查之一,但其投影性质限制了它所能显示的东西:肋骨、锁骨、鳞片、肺脏、介质和胸壁被叠加到一个二维平面上。 密集结构背后的检测结果与它们争夺对比,肺结核和早期肺癌经常在肋骨或锁骨重叠的地方被错过。 事实证明,在图像中进行刺杀骨头可以改善人体阅读器和计算机辅助检测系统对结核的检测(Li等人,2011年;Schalekamp等人,2013年;Bae等人,2022年;Frenkel等人,2025年),以及骨头抑制,即在保存病理学的同时去除肋骨和锁骨,是胸腔放射图的既定处理步骤。

blocks.en: Training a suppression model requires, for the same anatomy, the radiograph together with either the structure to be removed (a bone image) or what remains after its removal (a soft-tissue image); a single radiograph cannot supply such a pair, because superposition is not invertible from one acquisition. The classical source of such pairs is dual-energy subtraction (DES) radiography ( Loog et al., 2006 ; Chen and Suzuki, 2014 ) , which separates bone from soft tissue using two exposures at different tube potentials. DES data are scarce, however, because acquisition requires dedicated hardware; the subtraction also carries motion, noise, and cross-contamination artefacts, and DES-supervised methods have excluded clinically important conditions such as pneumothorax and pleural effusion from training and evaluation ( Sun et al., 2025b ) . Chest CT offers an alternative. A CT volume resolves the superimposed structures in three dimensions, so segmenting it into anatomical components and projecting each component separately yields a digitally reconstructed radiograph (DRR) together with its per-structure decomposition, registered to it pixel for pixel because every component is projected through the same geometry. Prior work has demonstrated the feasibility of this route for bone suppression ( Gozes and Greenspan, 2020 ; Ren et al., 2021 ) .
blocks.zh: 训练压制模型,对于同样的解剖学来说,需要放射图连同要去除的结构(骨像)或去除后的残余(软组织图像);单一放射图不能提供这种对子,因为一次获得的叠加不是不可逆的. 此类对子的古典来源是双能减法(DES)射线学(Loog等人,2006年;Chen and Suzuki,2014年),它利用不同管潜力的两次接触将骨骼与软组织分离. 然而,DES数据很少,因为获取需要专门的硬件;减值还带有运动、噪音和交叉污染的手工艺品,DES监督的方法将肺炎和胸膜输血等临床上重要的条件排除在培训和评价之外(Sun等人,2025b)。 胸围CT提供了一个替代方案。 一个CT卷解决了三维的叠加结构,因此将其分割成解剖元件,并且将每个元件分别投影产生一个数字重建的射电图(DRR)及其每个结构的分解,注册到它的像素上以像素表示,因为每个元件都是通过相同的几何来预测的. 先前的工作证明了这种骨头抑制途径的可行性(Gozes and Greenspan, 2020;Ren等人, 2021)。

blocks.en: Existing DRR generation, however, falls short of providing usable structure-suppression supervision in three respects (reviewed in Sec. 2.1 ). First, no released DRR engine supplies the per-structure projections this supervision needs. Most return one fused image per view; where an internal material split exists it is a coarse three-material one (air, soft tissue, bone) that is not exposed as an output; and the engines that can emit per-structure channels render a decomposition supplied to them (a labelled volume or material-assigned meshes), providing neither the chest-specific decomposition nor the bone-void inpainting needed to construct suppression targets. Second, naive threshold-based decomposition corrupts the supervision signal itself: dense non-osseous structures (diaphragm, calcifications, contrast-filled vessels) enter the bone mask as isolated three-dimensional islands and project as isolated opacities in the bone image, indistinguishable from focal findings (e.g. nodules) or vessel cross-sections. A model trained on such targets would learn to erase exactly the content it must preserve. Third, most pipelines map Hounsfield units (HU) to attenuation through a single global curve at one effective energy, although attenuation at diagnostic energies depends on both photon energy and material composition ( Watanabe, 1999 ) . The resulting images have limited contrast diversity and an unmistakably synthetic appearance, leaving a large domain gap to real radiographs. A further requirement follows from how we choose to suppress. Predicting the bone image and subtracting it from the radiograph is easier and safer than generating the soft-tissue image directly, which is free to alter the lung vasculature and parenchyma along with the bone, but the subtraction is exact only if the full radiograph is the pixel-wise sum of its components, which a physically rendered image is not. We therefore build this additivity into our DRRs by construction.
blocks.zh: 然而,现有的减少灾害风险生成工作未能在三个方面提供有用的结构压制监督(见第2.1节审查)。 首先,没有发布DRR引擎提供这种监督需要的每个结构的预测. 多数人返回每个视图一个熔化的图像;如果内部物质分裂存在,则是一个粗糙的三材料之一(空气、软组织、骨骼)不作为输出而暴露;而且每个结构通道能够释放的发动机使提供给它们的分解(标定体积或物料分配膜),既不能提供胸特分解,也不能提供构造抑制目标所需的骨沃涂料。 第二,天真的阈值分解会腐蚀监督信号本身:密集的非斜面结构(二叠纪,钙化,反相填充器皿)作为孤立的三维岛进入骨罩,并预测骨像中的孤立不透明,与焦距(如结核)或容器截面无法区分. 接受过有关此类目标的培训的模型将学会消除它必须保留的内容。 第三,大多数管道将Hounsfield单元(HU)图示为在一个有效能量下通过单一全球曲线进行衰减,尽管诊断能量的衰减取决于光子能量和材料组成(Watanabe,1999年)。 由此产生的图像具有有限的对比性多样性和无可掩饰的合成外观,给真实的放射图留下了很大的域间隙. 另一个要求是,我们如何加以压制。 预测骨头图像并从放射图中减去,比直接生成软质组织图像更容易安全,软质组织图像可以与骨头一起自由改变肺脏和parenchyma,但只有在完整的放射图是其组成部分的像素-视像素-总和时,才精确的减去,而物理渲染的图像则不是. 因此,我们通过建筑将这种附加性纳入我们的减少灾害风险。

blocks.en: In this paper, we present a DRR generation framework based on anatomy decomposition that turns a chest CT volume into radiograph supervision with pixel-registered per-structure targets, addressing all of the above. Stage 1 decomposes the CT into bone, non-lung soft-tissue, and lung components through an iterative, multi-threshold bone segmentation algorithm, renders each component separately under a per-tissue polychromatic HU-to-attenuation model, and composites the rendered projections additively, so the full radiograph is exactly the sum of its parts (Sec. 3.2 ). Stage 2 trains bone- and lung-component suppression models on these projections with a predict-and-subtract formulation; this is the pathway we validate on real-radiograph tasks (Sec. 3.3 ). Stage 3 , an extension of the first two stages, translates the bone and soft-tissue components onto the real-radiograph manifold with unpaired, content-preserving generators and recombines them; its target domain, which does not otherwise exist, is the real component images that the Stage-2 models produce from real radiographs (Sec. 3.4 ). The extension is motivated by task dependence: bone is structurally regular, so suppression can be learned from synthetic-looking projections under strong augmentation, whereas tasks that depend on subtle parenchymal texture need images that look real. Because the translation preserves content and is applied to each component separately (the lung is left untouched), the per-structure labels of the base DRR remain largely valid for the translated image (Sec. 4.5 ).
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提出一个基于解剖学分解的DRR生成框架,将胸腔CT体积转化为射电图监督,并配有像素注册的每个结构目标,处理所有上述问题. 第1阶段通过一个迭代的,多阈值的骨分化算法将CT分解为骨质,非隆起的软质组织,以及肺部部分,使每个部分在每问题多色HU-加速度模型下分别形成,合成得到的预测有添加作用,所以完整的射电图正是其部分的总和(第3.2节). 第2阶段用预测和减值配方对这些预测的骨骼和肺部元件抑制模型进行了培训;这是我们在实时辐射仪任务上验证的路径(第3.3条)。 第3阶段是前两个阶段的延伸,将骨质和软质问题组件翻译到真射线多面体上,并带有未发酵的,保存内容的生成器并重新压缩它们;它的目标域,除此之外不存在,是第2阶段模型从真实的射线图中产生的真正的组件图像(第3.4节). 扩展的动机是任务依赖性:骨骼在结构上是规律的,因此在强增强下从合成外观的预测中可以得知抑制,而依赖于细微的孔隙纹理的任务需要外观真实的图像. 由于翻译保存了内容,并分别应用于每个组件(肺部未受影响),因此基底DRR的每个结构标签对翻译图像(Sec. 4.5 )仍然基本有效.

blocks.en: We evaluate the framework along two axes. First, downstream lesion detection on TBX11K, Node21, and VinDr-CXR: the Stage-2 bone-suppression model, trained only on DRRs, improves detection over the full-radiograph baseline in most settings and ranks first among the released bone-suppression methods we could evaluate in every detector–dataset combination of the bone-suppressed arm (detectors trained on bone-suppressed CXRs) on TBX11K and Node21. A mechanistic analysis shows that, where the detector has room for improvement (Node21) over the full-xray baseline, the benefit concentrates on bone-overlapped lesions, and that within VinDr-CXR it is largest for the finding classes with the most bone overlap. Second, projection quality: against four open-source DRR generators rendering the same source CT volumes, our DRR base \mathrm{DRR}_{\text{base}} is already as realistic as their renders (FID 14.8 14.8 vs. 14.5 14.5 – 16.5 16.5 ) and carries comparable label-readable anatomy to the line-integral engines. Our translated output attains the best distributional realism (FID 8.2 8.2 vs. 14.5 14.5 for the best baseline), has approximately 2.6 2.6 – 3.8 3.8 times their lung-field Laplacian variance, and agrees best with the source CT’s own lung geometry under a CT-referenced cross-modal check. The main contributions of this work are summarised as follows: • An anatomy-decomposed, additively separable DRR generator, combining an artefact-controlled decomposition (iterative multi-threshold bone segmentation, 3D connected-component pruning, and density-domain void inpainting) with per-tissue polychromatic rendering based on ICRU Report 44 tissue compositions ( International Commission on Radiation Units and Measurements, 1989 ) , NIST XCOM cross-sections ( Berger et al., 2010 ) , and SpekPy tube spectra ( Bujila et al., 2020 ) . • Bone and lung-component suppression models whose only paired supervision is the synthetic per-structure projections. Applied in sequence, the two feed-forward networks decompose a real radiograph into its bone, lung-component, and non-lung soft-tissue images, and transfer to four public datasets without per-dataset adaptation. • A component-wise adaptation of an existing shortest-path unpaired translator ( Xie et al., 2023 ) , whose real-component target domain is produced by the suppression models themselves. • The first cross-domain, task-level comparison of released bone-suppression methods on lesion detection, a mechanistic analysis of when and why bone suppression helps, and realism and anatomical-fidelity comparisons against other open-source DRR engines on matched CTs.
blocks.zh: 我们沿两个轴线评估框架。 首先,对TBX11K、Node21和VinDr-CXR的下游病变检测:阶段-2骨压模型,只受过关于DRR的培训,改进了在大多数环境下对全射线基线的检测,在释放的骨压方法中排在首位,我们可以在TBX11K和Node21上对骨压臂的每个探测器-数据集组合(骨压CXR的检测器)进行评估。 一项机械分析显示,如果探测器比全轴基线有改进的余地(Node21),则其效益集中在骨部重叠的损伤上,而在VinDr-CXR范围内,其最大的发现类别是骨部重叠最多的。 第二,投影质量:利用四个开源的 DRR 发电机输出相同的源 CT 音量,我们的 DRR 基础\mathrm{ DRRR}_{\Text{base} 已经和它们的音量一样现实(FID 14.8 14.8 vs 14.5 14.5 – 16.5 16.5),并带有与线内发动机相似的可读标签解剖学. 我们的翻译产出达到了最佳的分布现实主义(FID 8.2 8.2 vs 14.5 14.5作为最佳基线),大约2.6 2.6 — 3.8 倍于其肺田拉普拉西亚差异,并且最同意来源CT自身肺几何在CT参照的交叉模式检查下。 这项工作的主要贡献概述如下: 解剖学-分解、可添加分离的DRR生成器,结合动脉控制分解(线粒体多阈值骨分解、3D连接元件分解、密度-域空插),并基于ICRU报告44组织组成(国际辐射单位和测量委员会,1989年)、NIST XCOM截面(Berger等人,2010年)和SpekPy管光谱(Bujila等人,2020年)。 骨和肺元件抑制模型,其唯一的对联监督是合成全结构预测。 按顺序应用,两个向导网络将一个真实的射电图分解成其骨骼,肺部组件,以及非隆起的软质组织图像,并转移到四个公共数据集,而不进行每个数据集的调整. • 支助 • 现有最短路径的无助翻译器(Xie 等人,2023年),其实际组件目标域由压制模型本身产生。 首次跨域任务级别比较了释放出的关于损伤检测的骨压方法,机械分析了骨头抑制何时及为何有帮助,以及现实主义和解剖-忠诚性比较了匹配CT上的其他开源DRR引擎.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 DRR synthesis and attenuation modelling
blocks.zh: 2.1 减少灾害风险的合成和衰减建模

blocks.en: DRR generation underpins radiotherapy, 2D/3D registration, and synthetic-data generation. Siddon’s algorithm ( 1985 ) and Jacobs et al.’s extension ( 1998 ) compute exact radiological path lengths through a voxel grid and remain the standard ray-driven foundation. More recent simulators add realism or differentiability: DeepDRR couples analytic projection with learned material decomposition, scatter, and noise ( Unberath et al., 2018 ) ; DiffDRR reformulates Siddon ray-casting as differentiable tensor operations ( Gopalakrishnan and Golland, 2023 ) ; and gVirtualXray implements Beer–Lambert attenuation with monochromatic or polychromatic spectra at high throughput ( Pointon et al., 2023 ) . Classical and reconstruction toolkits provide the same line-integral projection at production speed (Plastimatch ( Sharp et al., 2010 ) , TIGRE ( Biguri et al., 2016 ) ), while chest-specific variants alter the projection rule itself: softMip ( Meyer et al., 2008 ) sorts and weights the voxels along each ray and scored best in a recent comparative chest-CT → \rightarrow CXR DRR image-quality benchmark ( Paalvast et al., 2025 ) . A separate line pursues realism by learning it: RealDRR ( Dhont et al., 2020 ) post-processes ray-cast DRRs with a locally trained image-to-image translator, SyntheX ( Gao et al., 2023 ) instead randomises DeepDRR renderings so that downstream models transfer without photorealism, and Gaussian-splatting renderers replace the voxel grid with a fitted point model: X-Gaussian ( Cai et al., 2024 ) models view-independent radiation intensity for novel-view synthesis, and DDGS-CT ( Gao et al., 2024 ) adds direction-dependent terms to approximate anisotropic effects such as scatter. These target photorealism, 2D/3D registration ( Gao et al., 2020 ) , or novel-view synthesis; none supplies inpainted, per-tissue-rendered component projections that sum to the radiograph, although DiffDRR can project label maps and DeepDRR renders per-material attenuation internally. The HU-to-attenuation conversion is a key source of appearance variation and physical error, being nonlinear and material-dependent at diagnostic energies ( Watanabe, 1999 ; Bujila et al., 2020 ) . Rather than a single fixed-energy mapping, we model attenuation per tissue: we integrate material-specific coefficients from NIST XCOM cross-sections ( Berger et al., 2010 ) over realistic tube spectra generated by SpekPy ( Bujila et al., 2020 ) , and add scatter and quantum noise, capturing the spectral, material, and noise dependence of contrast without the cost of a full Monte-Carlo simulator.
blocks.zh: 减少灾害风险的生成是放射疗法、2D/3D登记和合成数据生成的基础。 Siddon的算法(1985年)和Jacobs等人的扩展(1998年)通过阴道网计算出精确的放射路径长度,并仍然是标准射线驱动的基础. 较近期的模拟器增加了现实主义或异性: DeepDRR夫妇用学习到的物质分解、散射和噪音分析投影(Unberath等人,2018年);DiffDRR将Siddon射线播报重新编订为可分辨的收音机操作(Gopalakrishnan和Golland,2023年);和gVirtualXray仪表 啤酒-兰伯特在高吞吐量时与单色或多色谱发生衰减(Pointon等人,2023年)。 古典和重建工具包在生产速度上提供相同的线-内置投影(Plastimpatch (Sharp et al., 2010),TIGRE (Biguri et al., 2016)),而胸特定变体则改变投影规则本身:柔性 Mip(Meyer等人,2008年)沿每条射线对阴道进行分类和加权,在最近比较的胸部-CT 中得分最高 =\右倾CXR DR 图像质量基准(Paalvast等人,2025年)。 一条单独的线通过学习追求现实主义: RealDRR(Dhont et al., 2020年) 处理后的射线发射 DRR, 配有当地训练的图像到图像翻译, SyntheX(Gao et al., 2023年) 代替随机化 DeepDRR 渲染, 使下游的模型在没有光现实主义的情况下转移, 高斯亚-镀层的渲染器用一个合适的点模型取代 voxel 网格: X-Gausian(Cai et al., 2024年) 小说合成的模型视效辐射强度, DDGS-CT(Gao et al., 2024年) 添加了方向依赖术语, 以接近散射等异构效. 这些目标光现实主义,2D/3D注册(Gao 等人,2020年),或新颖视野合成;没有供应被涂抹的,每问题递归的组件预测总和到放射图上,虽然DiffDRR可以投射标签地图,DeepDRR使每个物质在内部减弱. HU-加速度转换是外观变异和物理错误的关键来源,在诊断能量上是非线性并依赖物质的(Watanabe,1999年;Bujila等人,2020年)。 而不是单一的固定能图,我们模拟每个组织的衰减量:我们将NIST XCOM截面(Berger等人,2010年)中的材料特异性系数与SpekPy(Bujila等人,2020年)产生的现实管谱相融合,并添加散射和量子噪声,捕捉对比的光谱、材料和噪声依赖性,而无需完全的Monte-Carlo模拟器。

blocks.en: 2.1.1 Why existing DRR tools do not supply structure-suppression targets
blocks.zh: 2.1.1 国家 现有减少灾害风险工具为何不提供结构抑制目标

blocks.en: A natural question is whether an existing simulator could generate our training data directly. Our requirement is not a realistic full radiograph but per-structure projections (a bone image and its complementary soft-tissue image, and, for lung-component suppression, a lung-component image and a non-lung soft-tissue image) that sum to the input radiograph, so that a predict-and-subtract model can be supervised. Existing tools do not provide these. DeepDRR does decompose materials internally (a learned volumetric segmentation into air, soft tissue, and bone, with HU thresholding as its fallback ( Unberath et al., 2018 ) ), but the split is coarse, not chest-specific, and not exposed as supervision: under HU thresholding, dense non-osseous voxels (contrast-filled vessels, calcifications, catheters) enter the bone image; its complement is merely those voxels zeroed (a rib-shaped lucent imprint rather than the occluded tissue), and there is no lung or vascular class. Our 3D connected-component pruning and soft-tissue inpainting address exactly these failures. DiffDRR ( Gopalakrishnan and Golland, 2023 ) renders per-structure channels from a labelled CT volume and gVirtualXray ( Pointon et al., 2023 ) from material-assigned surface meshes, but neither supplies the decomposition itself: neither segments a chest CT nor inpaints the removed bone, so their components inherit whatever labelling or meshing they are given (we do not benchmark gVirtualXray because meshing the CT into per-material surfaces is itself a segmentation step). The remaining engines above return one fused image per view, and RealDRR ( Dhont et al., 2020 ) translates that fused image as a whole, so none supplies suppression targets. Our contribution at this stage is therefore a chest-specific, artefact-controlled, additively separable decomposition that directly yields the per-structure supervision these tasks need, which existing tools, as released, do not.
blocks.zh: 一个自然的问题是,现有的模拟器是否能够直接生成我们的培训数据。 我们的要求不是现实的全射电图,而是每个结构的投影(一个骨骼图像及其互补的软质图象,而对于肺部组件抑制,一个肺部组件图象和一个非隆起的软质图象),这些投影图与输入的射电图总和,从而可以监督一个预测和减量模型. 现有工具没有提供这些工具。 DeepDRR确实在内部分解材料(一种学习到的体积分解为空气,软组织,骨骼,以HU阈值为折返(Unberath等人,2018年)),但分解是粗糙的,不是胸口特异性的,也不是作为监理而暴露的:在HU阈值下,密集的非窒息性阴道(连续填充的血管,钙化,导管)进入骨质图像;其补充物仅仅是那些阴道零化的(肋状的润滑性印记而不是奥氏组织),没有肺或血管类. 我们的3D连通组件 修补和软问题 补漆的地址 正是这些失败。 DiffDRR(Gopalakrishnan和Golland,2023年)从标注的CT体积和标注的gVirtualXray(Pointon等人,2023年)从物质分配的表面母体中使每个结构的通道,但两者都不供应分解本身:既非胸腔CT,也非涂抹被切除的骨骼,因此其成分继承了所给予的任何标签或钉子(我们不把gVirtualXray作为基准,因为将CT放入材料表面本身就是一个分解步骤)。 上方的剩余引擎返回每个视图一个引信的图像,RealDRR(Dhont et al.,2020年)翻译了将图像整体引信,因此没有供应压制目标. 因此,我们在现阶段的贡献是胸口特异性、人工控制、可添加分解,直接产生每个结构监督这些任务所需的,而释放出来的现有工具并不如此。

blocks.en: 2.2 Unpaired image-to-image translation
blocks.zh: 2.2 图像到图像的未发音翻译

blocks.en: To extend the utility of DRRs beyond structure suppression to tasks that depend on realistic appearance, the domain gap to real radiographs has to be closed; because pixel-aligned DRR/real-CXR pairs were not available for our cohort, this requires unpaired translation. Cycle-consistent methods ( Zhu et al., 2017 ; Liu et al., 2017 ; Huang et al., 2018 ; Lee et al., 2020 ; Kim et al., 2020 ) preserve content by also learning the inverse mapping, whereas one-sided methods constrain the map itself: distance preservation ( Benaim and Wolf, 2017 ) , geometry consistency ( Fu et al., 2019 ) , patchwise contrastive learning ( Park et al., 2020 ; Han et al., 2021 ; Hu et al., 2022b ) , and, most relevant here, shortest-path regularisation (SANTA ( Xie et al., 2023 ) ); adversarial diffusion addresses the same unpaired setting in medical imaging ( Özbey et al., 2023 ) . We adopt SANTA’s shortest-path objective and its shared-decoder path formulation, but replace its ResNet-with-AdaIN generator and plain LSGAN discriminator with a latent MedVAE generator adapted through LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022a ) and a vision-aided CLIP discriminator ( Kumari et al., 2022 ) using medical-domain MedCLIP features ( Wang et al., 2022 ) , and we apply the translator per anatomical component rather than to the whole image.
blocks.zh: 要将 DRRs 的效用超越结构压制到依赖于现实外观的任务,域间隙必须关闭到真实的射电图上;因为像素相配的 DRR/real-CXR 配对对我们的组群来说是没有的,这需要不带色彩的翻译. 周期一致的方法 (Zhu等人,2017年;Liu等人,2017年;Huang等人,2018年;Lee等人,2020年;Kim等人,2020年) 通过学习反向绘图来保存内容,而片面方法则制约地图本身:距离保护(Benaim and Wolf,2017年),几何一致性(Fu等人,2019年),补丁对比学习(Park等人,2020年;Han等人,2021年;Hu等人,2022b),以及最相关的是短路径规范化(SANTA (Xie et al.,2023年);对抗扩散在医学成像中解决了同样的未受污染的设定(Özbey等人,2023年)。 我们采用SANTA最短路径目标及其共享解码路径配方,但用RResNet-Adain生成器和普通LSGAN歧视器替换为通过LORA(Hu等人,2022a)和视觉辅助的CLIP歧视器(Kumari等人,2022年),使用医学领域MedCLIP特征(Wang等人,2022年),我们应用每个解剖部分的翻译器而不是整个图像。

blocks.en: 2.3 CT-derived supervision for bone suppression
blocks.zh: 2.3 对骨骼抑制的CT衍生监督

blocks.en: Bone (rib/clavicle) suppression improves reader and CAD detection of pulmonary nodules ( Li et al., 2011 ; Schalekamp et al., 2013 ; Bae et al., 2022 ; Frenkel et al., 2025 ) . The classical supervised route requires paired dual-energy subtraction (DES) radiographs ( Loog et al., 2006 ; Chen and Suzuki, 2014 ) , which are scarce; convolutional and ensemble models ( Rajaraman et al., 2021 ; Rajaraman et al., 2022 ) and GAN- and diffusion-based methods ( Liu et al., 2020a ; Sun et al., 2025a ) learn the mapping from such pairs but can weaken subtle lesions ( Bae et al., 2022 ) . CT-derived DRR supervision sidesteps DES: Gozes and Greenspan ( 2020 ) and Ren et al. ( 2021 ) generate bone/bone-free DRR pairs and train CNNs, establishing feasibility. Recent diffusion- and consistency-model methods (BS-LDM ( Sun et al., 2025a ) and GL-LCM ( Sun et al., 2025b ) ) are trained on dual-energy pairs and optimise image-similarity to the DES reference, reporting strong pixel-level quality but evaluated only within their training domain. Our framework differs by (i) producing cleaner anatomical decompositions through connected-component pruning and soft-tissue inpainting; (ii) rendering each component separately under a tissue-specific, polychromatic HU-to-attenuation model and combining the projections additively to yield pixel-registered, per-structure targets that sum exactly to the full DRR; and (iii) addressing the domain gap for suppression through randomised tube potential, view geometry, component mixing, and aggressive contrast/style augmentation rather than by learning real-radiograph appearance; real radiographs enter only as histogram-matching targets during augmentation, helping the model learn to identify bone structures across variations in radiographic appearance. We further evaluate suppression by its effect on lesion detection rather than by similarity to a dual-energy reference.
blocks.zh: 骨(肋骨/膝盖)抑制能改善肺结核的读物和CAD检测(Li等人,2011年;Schalekamp等人,2013年;Bae等人,2022年;Frenkel等人,2025年)。 古典监督路线需要配对的双能减值(DES)射电图(Loog等人,2006年;Chen and Suzuki,2014年),这些射电图很少;演化和综艺模型(Rajaraman等人,2021年;Rajaraman等人,2022年)和基于GAN和传播的方法(Liu等人,2020年a; Sun等人,2025a)从这种对子中学习绘图,但可以削弱微妙的损伤(Bae等人,2022年)。 CT衍生的DRR监督旁观DES:Gozes and Greenspan (2020)和Ren等人. (2021)生成骨/骨无DRR对并训练CNN,建立可行性. 近期的推广和一致性模型方法(BS-LDM(Sun等人,2025a)和GL-LCM(Sun等人,2025b))都接受了双能对子的培训,并优化了DES参考图象的相似性,报告了强像素水平的质量,但只在培训领域进行了评估。 我们的框架不同之处在于:(一) 通过连接组件推磨和软质涂层,产生更清洁的解剖分解;(二) 通过组织特异性、多色HU到加速度模型,将每个组件分开,并结合预测,以产生像素登记的、每个结构的目标,精确地与全面的减少灾害风险相加;以及(三) 通过随机化管潜力、视差几何、组件混合和侵略性对比/式增强,而不是通过学习真射线外观,解决抑制的域间隙;真正的射线图只在扩增过程中作为直径比目标输入,帮助模型学习识别辐射外观不同结构的骨骼结构。 我们进一步评估抑制对病变检测的影响,而不是与双重能量参照相似。

blocks.en: 2.4 Synthetic augmentation for chest radiographs
blocks.zh: 2.4 胸腔放射图合成增强

blocks.en: Forward-projecting CT with inserted or annotated lesions provides controllable CXR training data: Schultheiss et al. project nodule-augmented CT to obtain exact lesion masks ( 2021 ) ; Shen et al. and Chung et al. show that synthetic nodules improve CXR detection ( Shen et al., 2023 ; Chung et al., 2022 ) . This line motivates the possibility that our translated, CT-labelled DRRs could serve as augmentation data.
blocks.zh: 带有插入或附加说明的损伤的前期预测CT提供可控制的CXR培训数据: Schultheiss等人项目结核强化CT,以获得准确的损伤口罩(2021); 沈等编著. Chung等人的报告 表明合成结核改进了CXR检测(Shen等人,2023年;Chung等人,2022年)。 这条线激发了我们翻译的、带有CT标签的减少灾害风险作为增强数据的可能性。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 概览

blocks.en: We divide our framework into three stages. Given a chest CT volume, Stage 1 decomposes it into three anatomical components (bone, non-lung soft tissue, and lung) and renders each component separately under a per-tissue polychromatic HU-to-attenuation model; because all components are projected through the same geometry, their projections are registered with one another pixel for pixel. The full radiograph is then assembled as a weighted pixel-space sum of the component projections (Sec. 3.2 ). This additive form is a modeling choice rather than the physics (under the Beer–Lambert law the components combine inside a single exponential), and we adopt it because the suppression models rely on the identity full radiograph = = sum of component images . Stage 2 trains neural network based bone- and lung-component suppression models using full DRRs as source and its components as targets; applied to real radiographs, the models decompose them into model-derived (pseudo-real) component images (Sec. 3.3 ). Stage 3 is an extension that translates the Stage-1 generated bone and soft-tissue components onto the real-radiograph manifold with unpaired, content-preserving generators, using the DRR components as its source domain and real components produced by Stage 2 as its target domain, and recombines them into DRR trans \mathrm{DRR}_{\text{trans}} (Sec. 3.4 ). Figure 1 summarises the complete framework.

blocks.en: 3.2 Stage 1: Anatomy-Decomposed Base Projection
blocks.zh: 3.2 第一阶段:解剖-解剖 基础投影

blocks.en: 3.2.1 Anatomical decomposition
blocks.zh: 3.2.1 解剖分解

blocks.en: We build Stage 1 around a three-way anatomical decomposition of the CT into bone, lung, and non-lung soft-tissue components (end-to-end pipeline in Algorithm 2 , A ). We segment bone first; a pretrained lung segmentation model ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) then splits the remaining anatomy into the lung component (the pulmonary vasculature together with the parenchyma and any intrapulmonary finding) and the non-lung soft tissue . Together with bone , the three masks partition the CT. The component volumes , however, are deliberately not a true partition. Removing the bone voxels leaves bone-shaped voids in the soft-tissue volume, and naively filled voids would project as rib-shaped imprints; we therefore fill them with iterative diffusion inpainting (Algorithm 4 , D ). The soft-tissue component thus carries an estimate of the anatomy hidden behind bone, not observed tissue. Together, the two components are exactly the pair a suppression model must learn to produce: the bone, and the same anatomy without it.
blocks.zh: 我们围绕一个三向解剖分解的阶段一,将CT分解成骨,肺,以及非隆起的软组织元件(在Algorithm 2, A.). 我们先是分骨;先是先经过训练的肺分化模型(赵等人,2025年),然后将剩余的解剖学分解为肺部分(肺分化与肺节化和任何肺内发现)和非肺软组织. 加上骨头,三个口罩分割了CT. 但是,组件量故意不是真正的分割。 切除骨头的阴道在软质体积中留下骨状的空穴,天真填充的空穴会显示为肋骨状的印记;因此,我们用迭代的扩散印记填充它们(Algorithm 4, D.). 因此,软组织成分包含对隐藏在骨骼后面的解剖学的估计,没有观测到的组织. 两部分是抑制模型必须学会的对子:骨骼和没有骨骼的同一解剖学。

Rendering therefore proceeds in two steps: a geometric step that projects each component’s density ρ c \rho_{c} , and a spectral step that applies its tissue-specific attenuation μ c ​ ( E ) \mu_{c}(E) .

blocks.en: (ii) Attenuation: spectrum and detector. An X-ray tube emits photons over a range of energies, and how strongly a tissue attenuates them depends on both the photon energy and the tissue’s make-up. The spectral step therefore combines three ingredients: a material model, a source model, and a detector model. Material : each component is assigned a fixed elemental composition from the ICRU Report 44 reference tissues ( International Commission on Radiation Units and Measurements, 1989 ) (e.g. the calcium and phosphorus content of bone), from which NIST XCOM photon cross-sections ( Berger et al., 2010 ) give its mass attenuation coefficient μ c ​ ( E ) \mu_{c}(E) , how strongly that tissue attenuates photons of energy E E (cm 2 /g; compositions and mixture rule in B ). Source : SpekPy ( Bujila et al., 2020 ) simulates the tube output for the chosen potential, giving the relative number of photons Φ ⁡ ( E ) \Phi(E) emitted at each energy (suppl. Sec. S1.1–S1.2). The tube potential enters the spectral model here: changing k ​ V ​ p kVp re-shapes Φ ⁡ ( E ) \Phi(E) , and with it every tissue’s effective attenuation, without re-projecting the volume. Detector : an energy-integrating detector records the total energy deposited by the photons that survive the patient, hence the weighting by E E below. At each energy, a fraction exp ⁡ ( − μ c ​ ( E ) ​ t c ) \exp(-\mu_{c}(E)\,t_{c}) of the beam survives (the Beer–Lambert law); summing over the spectrum, normalising by the flat-field signal (the same sum with no patient in the beam), and taking the negative log gives the pixel value P c ​ ( x , y ) = − log ⁡ ( ∑ E Φ ⁡ ( E ) ​ E ​ exp ⁡ ( − μ c ​ ( E ) ​ t c ​ ( x , y ) ) ∑ E Φ ⁡ ( E ) ​ E ) , P_{c}(x,y)=-\log\!\left(\frac{\sum_{E}\Phi(E)\,E\,\exp\!\big(-\mu_{c}(E)\,t_{c}(x,y)\big)}{\sum_{E}\Phi(E)\,E}\right), (5) in which the area density t c t_{c} of Eq. ( 4 ) meets its tissue’s μ c ​ ( E ) \mu_{c}(E) . P c P_{c} is 0 0 where the beam passes unattenuated and grows as more tissue accumulates along the ray, giving the component projections P BN P_{\mathrm{BN}} , P NL P_{\mathrm{NL}} , and P LN P_{\mathrm{LN}} . This is where per-tissue rendering pays off: low-energy photons are absorbed preferentially (beam hardening), and each composition absorbs them differently (calcium in bone most strongly, through the photoelectric effect), so every component’s contrast shifts with the tube potential in its own way, which a single global HU-to-intensity curve cannot reproduce. Equation ( 5 ) is the noise-free signal: in practice we add low-frequency scatter, Poisson photon noise, and a small detector blur before the log transform, and normalise each image to a common intensity range (constants in suppl. Sec. S1.2). Finally, a small set of per-component intensity scales and a tube-potential exposure factor calibrate the images toward the appearance of real radiographs (suppl. Sec. S1.2).

blocks.en: Taken together, the renderer is physics- informed rather than a physical simulation: each component is noise-corrupted and log-transformed on its own, and the bone component carries the full attenuation of the bone voxels while the inpainted tissue beneath them is also counted. The assembled image is therefore an empirically calibrated additive model, not the polychromatic transmission of the whole volume.
blocks.zh: 综合起来,渲染器是物理的——知情的,而不是物理的模拟:每个构件都是自成一团的噪声和日志转换的,骨骼构件背负着骨牛的全部衰减,而下方的涂抹组织也被计算在内. 因此组装的图像是一种经验校准的添加剂模型,而不是整个体积的多色传输.

blocks.en: 3.3 Stage 2: Bone and Lung-Component Suppression from Synthetic Supervision

blocks.en: In Stage 2 we put the Stage 1 projections to work as supervision. We train two suppression models, one removing bone and the other the lung component, with a predict-and-subtract recipe: the model predicts one component of the additive sum, and subtraction recovers the rest exactly. We apply both the models in sequence to decompose a real CXR into real lung, non-lung soft-tissue and bone component images, which later serve as the target domain for Stage 3 as well.
blocks.zh: 在第二阶段,我们把第一阶段的预测作为监督。 我们训练两种抑制模型,一种是去除骨骼,另一种是肺部元件,有一个预测和减法的配方:模型预测添加剂总和的一个成分,减法可以准确恢复其余部分. 我们用两种模型 来分解一个真正的CXR 成真正的肺部,非隆起的软组织 和骨骼组分的图像,它们后来也成为第三阶段的目标域。

blocks.en: 3.4 Stage 3: Unpaired, Component-wise Translation of the Projections

blocks.en: The DRR base \mathrm{DRR}_{\text{base}} is anatomically faithful, but it lacks the texture of a real detector image, and tasks that depend on realistic appearance need that gap closed. In Stage 3 we close it with component-wise image-to-image translation, learned unpaired (no aligned synthetic–real image pairs exist) and designed so that the per-structure labels of Stage 1 survive the change in appearance.

blocks.en: The complete pipeline works as follows. We translate two of the three synthetic components onto the real-radiograph manifold, bone P BN P_{\mathrm{BN}} and non-lung soft tissue P NL P_{\mathrm{NL}} , each with its own content-preserving generator; the lung component P LN P_{\mathrm{LN}} is left untouched. Because real counterparts of these components do not exist to train against, we create them: applied in sequence to a set of real radiographs, the two Stage-2 suppression models decompose each radiograph into a real bone image and a real non-lung soft-tissue image, and these become the translators’ target domains. Each generator adapts a shortest-path unpaired translator ( Xie et al., 2023 ) , which moves a synthetic component onto its real counterpart while a path-length penalty keeps the anatomy fixed. At inference we translate the two components, recombine all three by the additive rule of Sec. 3.2.3 , and obtain the translated radiograph DRR trans \mathrm{DRR}_{\text{trans}} , which still carries its CT-derived labels. The following subsections detail each part in turn.

blocks.en: The target domains must contain real component images, which do not exist natively: a real CXR is not pre-separated into bone and soft tissue. We create them with the Stage-2 models: bone suppression splits each real CXR into a real bone image and a real soft-tissue image, and lung-component suppression then removes the lung/vascular component from the latter, leaving a real lung-component-suppressed (non-lung) soft-tissue image. These two real components form the target domain (B) for the two generators, and the match to the source domain (A) is exact by construction: synthetic P BN P_{\mathrm{BN}} pairs with the real bone image, and synthetic P NL P_{\mathrm{NL}} , which is already free of the lung component, pairs with the real lung-component-suppressed soft-tissue image. The targets are model-derived , or pseudo-real: what the generators learn as “real bone” and “real soft tissue” is defined by the Stage-2 models, so any systematic error of theirs enters the target distribution.

blocks.en: 3.4.2 Why translate per component
blocks.zh: 3.4.2 联合国 为什么要翻译每个组件

blocks.en: We translate per component because a whole-image unpaired translator is free to alter or hallucinate structure anywhere, putting at risk the very lesions and markings we must preserve. Working per component also makes each mapping easier to learn: bone and non-lung soft tissue each have a narrower, more homogeneous appearance distribution than a full radiograph, so each dedicated generator learns a cleaner, lower-variance mapping. We leave the lung component untouched because its synthetic markings are the most fragile content to preserve.
blocks.zh: 我们翻译每个部件,因为一个全像无瑕疵的翻译可以任意改变或幻觉任何地方的结构,从而危及我们必须保存的伤害和标记。 每个组件的工作也使得每个绘图都更容易学习:骨和非齿软组织每个部分的外观分布比完整的射线图要窄,更加均匀,所以每个专用的生成器都会学习更清洁,变数较低的绘图. 我们未触及肺部成分,因为它的合成标记是保存最脆弱的成分。

blocks.en: We evaluate the framework under two protocols. The suppression protocol asks whether our bone-suppressed images improve downstream lesion detection on real radiographs, compared against released bone-suppression methods. The DRR generation protocol scores the projections themselves, comparing the realism and anatomical fidelity of our base and translated DRRs against open-source DRR engines. Both protocols draw their synthetic radiographs from CT-RATE ( Hamamci et al., 2026 ) , a public dataset of 25,692 25{,}692 non-contrast chest CT volumes from 21,304 21{,}304 patients with report-derived abnormality labels: we use the reconstructions with axial slice spacing ≤ 1 \leq 1 mm, one canonical volume per CT ( ∼ 21,887 \sim\!21{,}887 CTs), and train the suppression models on DRRs from a random ∼ 5000 \sim\!5000 -CT subset.

blocks.en: 4.2 Evaluation metrics
blocks.zh: 4.2 评价尺度

blocks.en: For the suppression protocol, our headline metric is the FROC CPM , the mean sensitivity over seven operating points between 0.125 0.125 and 8 8 false positives per image (the LUNA16/Node21 standard); intuitively, it is the fraction of true lesions a detector finds across clinically tolerable false-alarm rates. We report COCO mAP@50 alongside for comparability with the detection literature; it summarises the precision of the detector’s ranked boxes over all recall levels. For the FROC/CPM matching rule a box counts as a hit at IoU ≥ 0.3 \geq 0.3 ; mAP@50 uses the standard IoU ≥ 0.5 \geq 0.5 . For the mechanistic analysis we report recall at 2 2 false positives per image, at each model’s single global operating threshold, separately for bone-overlapped lesions and lesions with under 15 % 15\% overlap; this isolates exactly the lesions that bone suppression is meant to help. Consistent with our task-level thesis, we do not report image-similarity to DES references as a headline metric, for the reasons set out in Sec. 4.3 .

blocks.en: 4.3.3 Our BS vs. prior bone-suppression methods
blocks.zh: 4.3.3 我们的BS与以前的骨压方法

blocks.en: Holding the pipeline fixed and changing only the BS image source, we compare against the prior bone-suppression methods on both arms, with the isolating b ​ s bs arm as the primary comparison (Table 1 ). The comparators are CXR-BS (the released ResNet-BS model of Rajaraman et al. ( Rajaraman et al., 2021 ) , and the diffusion/consistency family: BS-LDM ( Sun et al., 2025a ) , GL-LCM ( Sun et al., 2025b ) , and DeBoneDiT ( Sun et al., 2026 ) . Two points frame the comparison fairly. First, BS-LDM, GL-LCM, and DeBoneDiT come from a single lineage trained on the same private DES dataset, so they are not independent methods; only CXR-BS is. We evaluated BS-Diff ( Chen et al., 2024 ) , the earliest member of that lineage, under the identical protocol (suppl. Table S2). It was the weakest method on TBX11K, and its b ​ s bs arm failed to train on Node21, so its three successors represent the lineage in the main tables. Second, we apply each baseline with its strongest released checkpoint, at its native resolution and without retraining. We claim no architectural or training-paradigm novelty, only a different source of supervision, so the released systems are the relevant comparators. This is also, to our knowledge, the first comparison of released bone-suppression systems on lesion-box detection under a shared detector protocol across these datasets. Under this protocol, ours is the only BS source that clears the shared full baseline on TBX11K on both detectors and matches it on Node21. On the b ​ s bs arm, ours ranks first among all bone-suppression methods in every one of the four detector × \times dataset cells, on both CPM and mAP@50. On RetinaNet every competitor’s b ​ s bs arm falls below full ; on Faster R-CNN the three that clear it do so by less than ours. Their soft-tissue image thus gives no consistent net detection benefit. They recover only in the f ​ u ​ l ​ l b ​ s full_{bs} fusion arm, which shows the deficit lies in the suppressed image rather than the fusion mechanism. The ranking is also consistent with a known handicap. CXR-BS renders at low native resolution ( 256 × 256 256\times 256 , up-scaled), which hurts small lesions most, whereas the higher-resolution DES-trained diffusion models still trail ours, so their gap reflects the suppression algorithm, not resolution. Beyond accuracy, our feed-forward predict-and-subtract model requires a single network evaluation rather than iterative sampling. This makes it substantially faster at inference (quantified in Table 11 against a flow-matching model).

blocks.en: 4.3.4 On image-similarity and preservation surrogates
blocks.zh: 4.3.4 国家 图像相似性和保存代孕

blocks.en: The prior diffusion methods report strong image-similarity scores (FID, KID, PSNR, LPIPS) against dual-energy subtraction (DES) references. These are metrics on which a method trained on DES pairs is expected to score well. We argue that this is not a valid cross-method measure of suppression quality, for two reasons. First, image-similarity to a DES reference rewards reproducing the DES distribution, artefacts included , rather than clinical correctness. DES soft-tissue/bone images carry inter-exposure motion and misregistration, reduced signal-to-noise from dose splitting, and residual bone/soft-tissue cross-contamination, so fidelity to them is not equivalent to a clean decomposition. A method trained and evaluated in the DES domain therefore holds a home-domain advantage on any DES-referenced metric, an advantage structurally unavailable to a method, like ours, whose targets are CT-derived. DES-referenced distributional metrics can therefore reflect domain match and are insufficient on their own to establish suppression quality. Second, the DES-supervised state of the art excludes pneumothorax and pleural-effusion studies from training and evaluation ( Sun et al., 2025b ) , so DES-referenced evaluation does not cover these clinically important conditions. We therefore evaluate suppression by its effect on downstream detection (Table 1 ) and by lesion conspicuity. On these measures, training on our CT-derived targets yields detection gains and increased lesion contrast that the diffusion baselines do not consistently achieve.
blocks.zh: 以往的传播方法报告,相对于双重能量减值(DES)参考,图像同比性分数很强(FID、KID、PSNR、LPIPS)。 这些衡量标准,在DES配对方面经过培训的方法,预期得分良好。 我们争辩说,出于两个原因,这不是一种有效的压制质量的跨方法措施。 首先,图像与DES参考的相似性奖励复制DES的分布,包括手工艺品,而不是临床正确性。 DES软质/骨质图像带有接触间运动和误测,剂量分裂产生的信号到噪声减少,残留的骨质/软质交叉污染,因此对它们的忠心不等于清洁分解. 因此,在DES领域受过训练和评价的一种方法在任何DES参考度量衡上都具有主域优势,在结构上对像我们这样的方法来说是没有的优势的,因为我们的目标就是CT。 因此,DES参考的分布度量衡可以反映域匹配,本身不足以确定抑制质量. 其次,DES监督的艺术状态将肺炎和胸膜增生研究排除在培训和评价之外(Sun等人,2025年b),因此DES参考评价不包括这些临床上重要的条件. 因此,我们通过对下游检测的影响(表1)和损伤性来评估抑制。 关于这些措施,关于我们CT衍生目标的培训可产生检测结果,与传播基线无法一致实现的损伤增加形成对比。

blocks.en: VinDr-CXR is a natural-prevalence, 14-class detection benchmark, and it behaves differently from the nodule/TB tasks. No BS variant yields a large, consistent gain over f ​ u ​ l ​ l full , and which method (if any) edges the baseline depends on the detector. We do not present VinDr as a win. Rather, it is the dataset that tests (and supports) our task-dependence hypothesis. Most VinDr findings are not rib/clavicle-occluded (e.g. cardiomegaly, where only 1.6 % 1.6\% of boxes overlap bone), so bone suppression has little to act on at the aggregate level. Table 4 reports detection under the ≥ 2 \geq 2 -radiologist-agreement label protocol (min_conf = 0.4 {=}0.4 ), whose training density matches the consensus test set. The pattern is consistent with our mechanistic account. On the weaker single-stage RetinaNet detector, ours is the only bone-suppression source that improves over f ​ u ​ l ​ l full in both arms; the b ​ s bs -arm gain is + 0.016 +0.016 CPM (single seed). On the stronger two-stage Faster R-CNN (both VinDr detectors are COCO-initialised), whose baseline already handles multi-finding detection well, the BS effect washes out, and GL-LCM (both arms) is the one that edges the baseline. Between-run variability was not estimated for VinDr, so these differences are reported descriptively.

On RetinaNet, ours has the largest positive Spearman association between per-class benefit and bone-overlap prevalence, and the only nominally significant positive one (Table 4 ), so the effect is concentrated on the minority of classes where bone is actually the problem and washed out in the 14-class average. Second, on the nodule/mass class (the focal, frequently occluded finding most comparable to TBX/Node21), ours is the only method that significantly increases lesion conspicuity, while every DES-trained diffusion baseline significantly decreases it (Table 13 ). We read the two together: VinDr’s muted aggregate is exactly what the task-dependence account predicts. On the bone-occluded findings within it, ours is the method that both preferentially improves detection and preserves lesion visibility.

blocks.en: 4.4 Lung-Component Suppression and Real-Radiograph Decomposition
blocks.zh: 4.4 肺元件抑制和真射线分解

blocks.en: We apply the two suppression models in sequence to decompose a real radiograph into the same components Stage 1 extracts from CT (Fig. 4 ). The bone-suppression model predicts the bone image, and subtraction leaves the soft tissue. The lung-component suppression model then predicts the lung-component image from that soft tissue, and a second subtraction yields the lung-component-suppressed soft tissue. These images are the real-domain counterparts of P BN P_{\mathrm{BN}} , P ST P_{\mathrm{ST}} , P LN P_{\mathrm{LN}} , and P NL P_{\mathrm{NL}} . Because both models are predict-and-subtract, the components sum back to the input radiograph by construction. The decomposition holds across three real datasets (JSRT, TBX11K, VinDr-CXR) without per-dataset tuning, and it supplies the real target domain for the component-wise translation (Sec. 3.4 ).

blocks.en: 4.5 Realism and Anatomical Fidelity of the Projections
blocks.zh: 4.5 预测的现实性和解剖性

blocks.en: Having established the downstream value of the synthetic supervision, we now assess the realism and anatomical fidelity of the generated radiographs. We evaluate two outputs: the DRR base \mathrm{DRR}_{\text{base}} and its translated form from Stage 3, DRR trans \mathrm{DRR}_{\text{trans}} . Every method is evaluated on the same 21,887 21{,}887 source CTs, with one PA image per CT at 100 100 kVp, ensuring that comparisons reflect differences in image generation rather than source CT selection.

blocks.en: 4.5.2 Fine-scale detail and texture
blocks.zh: 4.5.2 国家 细度细节和纹理

blocks.en: The line-integral DRRs of the open-source engines are visibly smooth: the projection averages over the CT’s slice thickness and in-plane sampling, and the fine parenchymal texture of a detector image is not present in the source volume. Three measurements (Table 6 ) show that our DRR base \mathrm{DRR}_{\text{base}} is already less smooth than the engines’ renders and that translation supplies fine-scale detail and texture statistics that none of them has. Whether that detail is anatomically correct is a separate question, addressed in Sec. 4.5.3 . On lung texture the DRR base \mathrm{DRR}_{\text{base}} is closer to real radiographs than every baseline by a wide margin (GLCM entropy Wasserstein distance ( Haralick et al., 1973 ) 0.40 0.40 vs. 0.75 0.75 – 0.96 0.96 ). On the frequency and sharpness axes, which reward resolution that no rendering model supplies at 512 × 512 512\times 512 , the DRR base \mathrm{DRR}_{\text{base}} is comparable to the baselines (spectral L 2 L_{2} 19.7 19.7 vs. 15.8 15.8 – 19.6 19.6 ; whole-image variance of Laplacian ( Pech-Pacheco et al., 2000 ) 16.9 16.9 vs. 12.7 12.7 – 28.1 28.1 ). Inside the lung field it is already sharper ( 18.2 18.2 vs. 6 6 – 9 9 ). The translated radiograph’s radially-averaged power spectrum ( Solomon et al., 2012 ) is 6.9 × 6.9\times closer to real CXR than the best baseline’s (spectral L 2 L_{2} 2.27 2.27 vs. 15.8 15.8 ): the frequency profile of a real detector image is supplied by the translator, not by upsampling. Its Laplacian sharpness is above every baseline, both whole-image ( 31.0 31.0 vs. 28.1 28.1 for DeepDRR) and, more markedly, inside the lung field ( 23.7 23.7 vs. 6.2 6.2 – 9.2 9.2 , approximately 2.6 2.6 – 3.8 3.8 times the baselines’). It nonetheless remains well below real VinDr ( 291 291 ): the 512 × 512 512\times 512 render bounds the resolution, and translation adds spectral content within that bound rather than resolution beyond it. On GLCM entropy the translated radiograph is the closest generator to real ( 0.31 0.31 vs. 0.75 0.75 for the best baseline, 2.4 × 2.4\times closer).
blocks.zh: 开源发动机的直线内向DRR明显光滑:在CT的切片厚度和飞机内采样上投影平均值,而探测器图像的细微凹槽纹理不见于源量中。 3个测量(表6)显示,我们的DRR基础\mathrm{DRR}_{\text{base}已经比引擎制造的更不光滑,而且翻译提供了它们都没有的精细尺寸的细节和纹理统计。 这种细节在解剖学上是否正确是一个单独的问题,在Sec中述及。 4.5.3 (中文(简体) ). 在肺纹理方面,DRR基础\mathrm{DRRQText{base}比每个基线都远近(GLCM entropy Wasserstein距离(Haralick等人,1973年)0.40 040对0.75 0.75–0.96 0.96)。 在频率和锐度轴上(奖励在512×512 512\时间512不能提供模型供应的分辨率),DRR基础\mathrm{DRRR}_{\text{base}可与基线(光谱L2 L_{2}19.7 19.7 vs 15.8 15.8 – 19.6 19.6; Laplacian(Pech-Pacheco et al., 2000) 16.9 16.9 vs 12.7 12.7 – 28.1 28.1 ) 肺部已较锐度(18.2 18.2 vs.6 – 9 9)。 被翻译的射电图的射线平均功率谱(Solomon et al., 2012)比最佳基线(光谱L 2 L_{2}2.27 2.27 vs 15.8 15.8):真探测器图像的频率剖面由翻译提供,而不是通过采样提供,离真CXR更近. 它的Laplacian锐度高于每个基线,既包括全像(31.0 31.0 vs 28.1 28.1 deepDRR),也包括肺部领域(23.7 23.7 vs 6.2 9.2 9.2, 大约2.6 2.6 3.8 倍基线)。 然而,它仍然远远低于真实的VinDr(291 291):512×512 512\times 512使决议具有约束性,翻译在约束性范围内而不是在解析度之外增加光谱含量。 在GLCM entropy上,翻译的射电图是最接近真实的生成器(最佳基线0.31 0.31对0.75 0.75,2.4×2.4\x更接近).

blocks.en: 4.5.3 Anatomical fidelity
blocks.zh: 4.5.3 解剖忠诚

blocks.en: Realism is necessary but not sufficient; the projected anatomy must also be correct . We assess this in three ways (Table 7 ). (i) A frozen classifier, trained only on real CheXpert radiographs and never on synthetic data, reads clinical findings from each generator’s images; we score these readings against the source CT’s labels. We average over the four findings whose definition matches 1 : 1 1{:}1 between the CT and radiograph label sets ( pleural effusion, atelectasis, cardiomegaly, consolidation ) and report their classwise AUROC scores and their macro-average as AUROC-4. We exclude the two remaining shared names because they denote different concepts in the two label sets: the CT label groups ground-glass and density increase under lung opacity , and counts fissural nodules as lung lesion . Neither is therefore a fair test of what a radiograph shows. The DRR base \mathrm{DRR}_{\text{base}} reads at 0.768 0.768 , level with the line-integral engines ( 0.772 0.772 – 0.782 0.782 ) and 0.032 0.032 below DeepDRR ( 0.800 0.800 ). DeepDRR’s poly-energetic render with a learned material model carries the most label-readable signal of any raw projection. Translation leaves this label-readable content essentially unchanged at the population level ( 0.768 → 0.773 0.768\rightarrow 0.773 ) while lowering FID by a third or more (Table 6 ). This is an aggregate statement: equal AUROC does not guarantee that every finding is preserved in every image, and we read it together with the CT-referenced check in (iii). On label-readability, then, our images are comparable to the fused renders. Class-wise, the base DRR leads all generators on consolidation ( 0.773 0.773 , tied with DeepDRR). Atelectasis is the hardest class for every generator, ours included, and DeepDRR keeps its edge on effusion and atelectasis.
blocks.zh: 现实主义是必要的,但还不够;预测的解剖学也必须正确。 我们以三种方式评估这一点(表7)。 (一) 一个冷冻分类器,只接受过真正的切克斯珀特放射图的培训,从未接受过合成数据的培训,它阅读了每个生成器的图像的临床结果;我们对照来源CT的标签对这些读数进行评分。 我们平均在定义符合1:1{:}1的CT和放射图标签套件(胸膜充血、心电图、合并)的四个结果中,并报告其分类的AUROC分数和宏观平均值为AUROC-4。 我们排除了剩下的两个共同名称,因为它们在两个标签组中表示不同的概念:CT标签组在肺部不透明的情况下将地镜和密度增加,并将裂变结核算作肺损伤。 因此,也不能公正地检验放射图显示什么。 DRR基础\mathrm{DRRQQText{base}读作0.768 0.768,水平与线内引擎(0.772 0.772 – 0.782 0.782 ) 和 0.032 0.032 低于 DeepDRR (0.800 0.800 0.80 ) 。 DeepDRR的多能渲染器带有任何原始投影的最可读标签信号。 翻译使这种可读标签的内容在人口一级基本保持不变(0.768 ~ 0.773 0.768\ 右侧0.773),同时将FID降低三分之一或更多(表6)。 这是一个汇总语句:平等的AUROC并不能保证每个发现在每一个图像中都保留下来,我们一起阅读了它和CT参考的检查(三). 那么在标签可读性方面,我们的图像与引信的成像相当。 类,基底DRR引导所有发电机进行合并(0.773 0.773,与DeepDRR绑定). Atelectas是每个发电机最难的一门, 包括我们的, DeepDRR 保持它的边缘 在洗涤和electasis。

blocks.en: (ii) An independent CXR anatomy segmenter, the 14-structure PSPNet ( Zhao et al., 2017 ) released with TorchXRayVision ( Cohen et al., 2022 ) and trained on ChestX-Det ( Lian et al., 2021 ) , detects 12.9 12.9 – 13.4 / 14 13.4/14 structures on our images. The DRR base \mathrm{DRR}_{\text{base}} ( 12.94 12.94 ) sits between the line-integral engines and DeepDRR ( 13.02 13.02 ), within the baselines’ range ( 12.5 12.5 – 13.0 13.0 ), and translation raises the count to 13.41 13.41 , above every baseline. The cardiothoracic ratio separates the arms more sharply. The DRR base \mathrm{DRR}_{\text{base}} ’s distance from the real distribution ( 0.078 0.078 ) is in the baselines’ range ( 0.056 0.056 – 0.088 0.088 ), and translation brings it to 0.025 0.025 , which is 2.2 2.2 – 3.5 × 3.5\times closer than any baseline. These are population-level agreements; we test subject-specific correctness next.

blocks.en: (iii) To assess agreement with the source CT’s own lung geometry rather than with real-image statistics, we compare against CT ground truth : the IoU between each projected lung field and the source CT’s own projected lung bounding box. Every arm of ours agrees with the CT anatomy better than every baseline ( 0.44 0.44 – 0.45 0.45 vs. 0.40 0.40 – 0.41 0.41 , DeepDRR lowest at 0.403 0.403 ). The DRR base \mathrm{DRR}_{\text{base}} scores 0.443 0.443 , and translation leaves it unchanged to slightly higher ( 0.451 0.451 ); at the level of lung-field geometry, then, translation does not distort the projected anatomy. This bounding-box measure rules out gross geometric distortion, not changes to individual small findings. Because it is referenced to the source CT’s own geometry rather than to real-image statistics, it tests anatomical correctness rather than realistic appearance, although the projected lung field is itself delineated by a CXR segmenter.
blocks.zh: (三) 为了评估与来源CT自己的肺几何而不是与真实图像统计的一致,我们比较了来源CT的地面真理:每个预测肺场之间的IoU和来源CT自己的预测肺界框。 我们的每个臂部都同意CT解剖学比每个基线(0.44 0.44 – 04.5 0.45对0.40 0.40 – 0.41 0.41,DeepDRR最低为0.403 0403)更好. The two Stage-1 ablations are measured on a fixed 5,000 5{,}000 -CT subset of CT-RATE (z-spacing 0.50 0.50 – 1.00 1.00 mm; 100 100 kVp PA-view projections); both are reference-free: mask-space statistics for bone segmentation and projection-space statistics for the void fill.

blocks.en: 5.1 Bone segmentation
blocks.zh: 5.1 骨分割

blocks.en: We compare three increasingly refined bone masks, added cumulatively (Fig. 6 ): a single fixed HU threshold ; our iterative multi-threshold, neighbourhood-filtered mask; and iterative + + connected-component pruning (full). Iterative filtering recovers fine bone and removes diaphragm artefacts, and pruning removes the tens-to-hundreds of small disconnected components per CT that otherwise project as isolated opacities, exactly the artefact that would be expected to teach a suppression model to erase true focal findings.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了三个日益精炼的骨罩,累积增加(图6):一个单一的固定HU阈值;我们的迭代多阈值,邻里过滤的面具;以及迭代+ + 连接-组件的挤压(完全). 迭代过滤可以回收精细的骨骼,去除隔膜的手工艺品,推拉可以去除每CT中成千上万个小的断开部件,这些部件本来会投射为孤立的不透明,而这正是预计会教给抑制模型以抹去真正焦点发现的芳香.

blocks.en: Table 9 quantifies both effects. A single threshold leaves a typical CT with ∼ \sim 318 disconnected components, projecting as noise for the bone-suppression model supervision and the slightly larger islands imitating lung opacities and vasculature. Pruning collapses this to a median of 2 2 (the coherent left/right skeleton), removing a median 99.2 % 99.2\% of the components while retaining 99.31 % 99.31\% of the bone volume (all values are per-CT medians; the median deleted volume is 8.6 cc; dividing the median volumes in the table gives 99.0%, since a ratio of medians differs from the median of per-CT ratios). The effect is sharpest on noisy thin-slice reconstructions, which collapse from 1.4 1.4 M to 5 5 components, with 30 30 – 37 % 37\% of their pre-prune “bone” being speckle. The iterative ladder adds + 316 +316 cc of volume ( 932 → 1248 932\rightarrow 1248 cc). Three structural signatures are consistent with this being low-density bone margin rather than accreted soft-tissue noise: growth is bone-anchored by construction (Eq. ( 1 ) admits a lower-HU voxel only with already-accepted bone in its neighbourhood); the component count falls ( 318 → 201 318\rightarrow 201 ) where scattered noise would raise it; and the added voxels survive connectivity pruning (the largest-component fraction rises 0.856 → 0.975 0.856\rightarrow 0.975 , and pruning subsequently removes only ∼ \sim 0.7 % 0.7\% of the volume). We note this is a structural argument, not a per-voxel comparison against a bone segmentation ground truth, which CT-RATE lacks.

blocks.en: 5.2 Soft-tissue void inpainting
blocks.zh: 5.2 软问题空插

blocks.en: Removing bone leaves a void (mean 2.9 % 2.9\% of the soft-tissue volume) that must be filled before projection. We compare six fills: three constants ( air at − 1000 -1000 HU, − 𝟓𝟎 \mathbf{-50} HU, water at 0 0 HU), nearest-value propagation (Euclidean distance transform), slice-wise Telea inpainting, and our iterative 3D diffusion inpainting. We score each fill by the bone-edge ratio : how concentrated the soft-tissue projection’s gradient energy is at locations where the bone projection has edges, normalised by the image’s own mean gradient; lower means less bone-shaped structure survives the fill. The ratio never reaches 1.0 1.0 (real anatomy has genuine edges near bone), so the spread is what matters, not the absolute value; the rim ratio restricts the same test to the top-decile bone rim.
blocks.zh: 删除骨头会留下一个空位(相当于软组织体积的2.9%),在投影前必须填充. 我们比较了六个填充物:三个常数(空气在-1000-1000 HU, −50\ mathbf{-50} HU,水在0 HU),最近的值传播(Euclidean距离变换),片面Telea涂料,以及我们的迭代3D扩散涂料。 我们用骨尖比来计算每个填充的分数:软质投影的梯度能量如何集中在骨头投影有边缘的地方,由图像本身的平均梯度来正常化;更低的表示骨质结构较少能活下来。 比例从未达到1.01.0(真正的解剖学有接近骨骼的真缘),因此传播是关键所在,而不是绝对值;环比将相同的测试限制在顶端的十进制骨膜上.

blocks.en: Diffusion inpainting leaves the least bone-shaped residue on the primary bone-edge ratio, on which the ordering across all six fills is monotone (Table 9 ); on the rim ratio the constant − 50 -50 HU fill is marginally ahead ( 0.990 0.990 vs. 0.992 0.992 ). The separation is clear against the naive constant fills: air ( + 0.159 +0.159 ) and water ( + 0.051 +0.051 ) leave rib-shaped lucent or dense imprints that also inflate the rim ratio ( 1.320 1.320 / 1.046 1.046 ). The margin over the best classical fills (Telea, nearest, constant − 50 -50 HU; + 0.012 +0.012 – 0.016 0.016 ) is small relative to the per-CT spread ( SD ≈ 0.07 \mathrm{SD}\approx 0.07 ), although the mean ordering is stable at n = 5,000 n{=}5{,}000 . Diffusion inpainting thus matches or beats the best classical inpainting while avoiding the gross bone-shaped artefacts of constant fills.

blocks.en: We claim no architectural novelty: the suppressor is an off-the-shelf SwinV2-Base ( Liu et al., 2022 ) + + UNet++ ( Zhou et al., 2018 ) trained on our projections. As a sanity check on the choice, Table 11 compares it against a a flow-matching variant (DiT-B/2 ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) ) on identical targets: the single-pass model leads by 0.04 0.04 CPM on TBX11K and the flow model drops sharply on Node21, most likely because it is trained at 512 × 512 512\times 512 (a 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 flow model is prohibitively expensive) and the resize loses small-nodule structure. Given the flow model’s far higher inference cost (below), the single-pass model is the better choice. The evidence that the projection drives our gains comes from the projection-side ablations (Secs. 5.1 and 5.2 ) and the comparison in Table 1 .

blocks.en: 6 Mechanistic Analysis: When and Why Bone Suppression Helps
blocks.zh: 6 机械分析:何时和为何切断骨骼帮助

blocks.en: Our downstream results (Sec. 4.3 ) show bone suppression helps on TBX11K and is near-neutral on Node21 and VinDr-CXR. This section asks why, and finds a consistent answer: the benefit tracks how much pathology is occluded by bone (Sec. 6.1 ), and the methods that help on small occluded lesions are those whose suppressed image increases lesion conspicuity rather than flattening it (Sec. 6.2 ). These analyses are correlational and, where noted, single-seed. The strongest evidence comes from the comparisons that hold a dataset fixed and vary bone overlap within it (Sec. 6.1 ): the multi-seed Node21 subgroup analysis and the correlation across VinDr’s 14 finding classes.
blocks.zh: 我们的下游结果(第4.3条)显示,对TBX11K的骨骼抑制作用很大,在Node21和VinDr-CXR上几乎是中性的。 本节询问为什么,并找到一个一致的答案:效益跟踪了有多少病理学被骨骼所吞噬(第6.1节),帮助小孔损伤的方法是那些被压抑的图像会增加损伤感而非使其扁平的方法(第6.2节)。 这些分析是相互关联的,如果注意到,是单一种子。 最强的证据来自持有一个数据集固定且内部不同骨重合的比较(Sec.6.1):多种子节点21分组分析以及VinDr的14个发现类的关联性.

blocks.en: 6.1 Bone-suppression benefit tracks bone overlap
blocks.zh: 6.1 骨压效益

blocks.en: We tag each ground-truth lesion as bone-overlapped if at least 15 % 15\% of its bounding-box pixels fall on bone, using the bone map predicted by our own suppressor, cross-checked qualitatively against the independent CXAS segmenter ( Seibold et al., 2023 ) . Using a common tag keeps the grouping consistent across methods, but its derivation from our suppressor may bias the association. Our primary evidence is the comparisons that hold a single dataset fixed and vary bone overlap within it, where imaging protocol, annotation framework, detector and evaluation are constant.
blocks.zh: 如果至少15%的边框像素落在骨头上, 我们用我们自己的抑制器预测的骨头图, 使用共同的标记使组合在方法上保持一致,但来源于我们的抑制器可能会对关联产生偏见. 我们的主要证据是将一个单一的数据集固定在其中,并且其骨骼重叠不一的比较,即成像协议、注释框架、探测器和评价是恒定的。

blocks.en: 6.1.1 Within-dataset evidence
blocks.zh: 6.1.1 数据集内的证据

blocks.en: Two analyses vary bone overlap inside a single dataset. The first is the Node21 subgroup analysis (Table 2 ): the recall gain from bone suppression concentrates on bone-overlapped nodules in all four detector/arm cells, with the direction consistent across all three seeds ( 46 46 overlapped lesions, so individual cells carry wide uncertainty).
blocks.zh: 两项分析在单一数据集内不同骨骼重叠. 第一个是Node21分组分析(表2):在所有四个探测器/臂细胞中,骨压浓缩在骨覆的结核上,其回旋收益与所有三个种子的方向一致(46个重叠损伤,因此单个细胞具有广泛的不确定性)。

blocks.en: The second uses VinDr’s 14 finding classes, which share a dataset, annotation framework and evaluation protocol while bone-overlap prevalence ranges from 36.0 % 36.0\% (pneumothorax) to 1.6 % 1.6\% (cardiomegaly); the classes still differ in lesion characteristics, frequency and detection difficulty. We correlate each class’s bone-overlap prevalence with its detection change ( Δ \Delta CPM, b ​ s − f ​ u ​ l ​ l bs-full ) across the 14 classes (Table 4 ). On RetinaNet, ours has the largest positive Spearman point estimate and the only nominally significant one ( ρ = 0.565 \rho{=}0.565 , p = 0.035 p{=}0.035 , uncorrected across the sixteen reported coefficients); GL-LCM is positive but not significant ( ρ = 0.455 \rho{=}0.455 , p = 0.102 p{=}0.102 ) and CXR-BS and DeBoneDiT are near zero, and a significant correlation for one method alongside a non-significant one for another does not by itself establish a difference between them. The association does not reproduce on Faster R-CNN, where no method shows a positive correlation and CXR-BS shows a nominally significant negative one ( ρ = − 0.587 \rho{=}-0.587 ), which may reflect the loss of small bone-region findings in its 256 × 256 256\times 256 output after upscaling; Faster R-CNN is also the stronger baseline on the bone-overlapped classes, leaving less headroom. These correlations are single-seed with small per-class box counts.

blocks.en: The prevalence of bone-overlapped lesions also varies sharply across the three datasets (Table 12 ) and runs in the same direction as the strength of the bone-suppression benefit: TBX11K, where nearly half of all lesions are bone-overlapped, shows the clearest gains, whereas VinDr-CXR, where over half of findings have no bone contact, shows no consistent benefit. blocks.en: 7 Discussion
blocks.zh: 7 讨论情况

blocks.en: Two design decisions drive the results. First, clean anatomical decomposition (iterative bone segmentation with connected-component pruning and inpainting) makes the DRR supervision trustworthy; without it, the suppression target is contaminated by spurious opacities that are not present in the underlying anatomy. The ablations of Sec. 5 show that the decomposition is cleaner, and Sec. 4.3.3 shows that our data-and-model system generalises better than the released systems; but the released baselines differ from ours in training data, architecture, resolution, and losses at once, and we have not retrained our own suppressor on threshold-based supervision. We therefore attribute the gain to the system as a whole (the CT-derived supervision together with the architecture, resolution, and augmentation trained on it) rather than to the training data in isolation. Two observations nonetheless point at the data: the neural network architecture we use is not more elaborate than those of the diffusion baselines, so an architectural advantage is not the obvious explanation; and the qualitative failure modes of the baselines (flattened parenchyma, standing clavicles) are precisely the defects a clean, complete decomposition removes from the training target. Second, component-wise, content-preserving translation is what extends the framework beyond suppression: it lifts the projections to real-radiograph appearance (Sec. 4.5 ) without surrendering the CT-derived per-structure labels (the shortest-path regulariser and per-component design constrain the translator to appearance, leaving the lung component untouched entirely), so the supervision survives the realism it gains.
blocks.zh: 两个设计决定驱动结果. 首先,干净的解剖分解(骨骼分解与连接成份的分解)使减少灾害风险监督值得信赖;没有这种分解,抑制目标就会受到基础解剖中不存在的虚假不透明因素的污染。 Sec. 5的分解显示分解较清洁,Sec. 4.3.3显示我们的数据和模型系统比释放的系统更通用;但释放的基线在培训数据,架构,解析度,以及损失方面却与我们同时不同,我们还没有在阈值监督下重新训练自己的抑制器. 因此,我们把收益归结于整个系统(CT产生的监督以及就此培训的结构、分辨率和增强),而不是孤立的培训数据。 然而,有两个观察点在数据上: 我们使用的神经网络架构 并没有比扩散基线的架构更详细, 所以建筑优势不是明显的解释; 基线的质量故障模式(平缓的parenchyma, 站立的clockles) 正是缺陷 一个干净的,完整的分解 从训练目标中移除。 其次,从组件角度来说,保存内容的翻译是将框架扩展到压制之外的原因:它将预测提升到真射线外观(Sec. 4.5),而不交出CT衍生的每个结构的标签(最短路径的常规化和每个组件的设计会限制翻译的外观,使肺部组件完全不受影响),因此监督维持它所获得的现实主义.

blocks.en: The downstream evaluation is deliberately task-level. Image-similarity metrics reward visually plausible suppression but are blind to whether subtle lesion signal survives. Our detection results show that prior BS methods, despite strong image quality, often fail to beat the full-CXR baseline once fed to a detector, whereas our bone-suppressed images help, most on the bone-overlapped lesions the method targets. The two-channel f ​ u ​ l ​ l b ​ s full_{bs} arm matched or exceeded f ​ u ​ l ​ l full on CPM in every TBX11K and Node21 setting and differed from it by − 0.006 -0.006 CPM on VinDr (Faster R-CNN, single seed), so it is the conservative choice when a task’s lesions may be small. We note that several of these differences are small relative to seed variability and that VinDr is single-seed.
blocks.zh: 下游评价是故意的任务级别。 图像-同质性衡量标准可以刺激视似的抑制,但对微妙的损伤信号是否继续存在却视而不见。 我们的检测结果显示,以往的BS方法,尽管图像质量很强,但一旦输入到检测器上,往往无法击败完整的CXR基线,而我们的骨压图像则有帮助,大多数在骨压损伤上,方法的目标。 每一次TBX11K和节点21的设置中,双通道的臂部与CPM匹配或超过fu l l l l, 我们注意到,其中一些差异与种子的可变性相比很小,VinDr是单一种子。

blocks.en: Our analysis (Sec. 6 ) reframes what a bone-suppression method should be expected to do: its benefit tracks the fraction of pathology actually occluded by bone, which varies widely across datasets (from 46 % 46\% of lesions on TBX11K to 15 % 15\% on VinDr-CXR) and across finding classes (from 36 % 36\% for pneumothorax to 2 % 2\% for cardiomegaly). This is consistent with JSRT-era, nodule-centric evaluations having overstated the universal value of bone suppression, and with the muted aggregate effect on a natural-prevalence benchmark such as VinDr-CXR. On VinDr’s per-class analysis, ours has the largest positive association between benefit and bone-overlap prevalence on RetinaNet and the only nominally significant one; the association does not reproduce on Faster R-CNN. We lean on the within-dataset analyses, and on the multi-seed Node21 subgroup result in particular, as the primary evidence.
blocks.zh: 我们的分析(Sec.6)重新定义了骨压方法的预期作用:其好处是追踪骨骼实际占据的病理学的一小部分,这些病理学因数据集(从TBX11K的46%46 %到VinDr-CXR的15%15 %)和发现类(肺炎的36%36 %到心肺的2%2 %)而有很大差异。 这与JSRT时代以结核为中心的评价过分夸大了骨头抑制的普遍价值,也与对VinDr-CXR等自然流行基准的微弱综合效应是一致的。 在VinDr的每类分析中,我们在RetinaNet上的受益率和骨折率之间有着最大的正比关系,也是名义上唯一重要的;该协会没有在更快的R-CNN上复制。 我们依靠内部数据集分析,特别是多种子节点21分组的结果,作为主要证据。

blocks.en: We are precise about the image-level claim. We do not claim the largest raw bone-removal score: the DES-trained diffusion methods remove more rib-band energy than we do (Sec. 6.3 ), but at full resolution they do so while either losing clear-lung detail or replacing it with image-dependent injected texture, whereas ours stays close to the retention target with a tight spread. CXR-BS, the one non-diffusion baseline, is comparable to us once scored on its native 256 × 256 256\times 256 grid and over-sharpens on JSRT; its near-zero retention at 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 is a resolution effect, not a property of the method. What separates ours from every baseline is therefore not an image-level trade-off but lesion conspicuity and detection: ours is the only method with a statistically supported mean CNR increase for small nodules on both Node21 and the VinDr nodule/mass class (Sec. 6.2 ), and the only bone-suppressed input that beats the full radiograph on TBX11K on both detectors and matches it on Node21 (Table 1 ). Conceding the raw bone-removal number while claiming the conspicuity and detection results is deliberate: standard image-quality surrogates do not separate methods on what matters clinically, which is exactly why we evaluate at the task level.
blocks.zh: 我们对图像层面的索赔是准确的。 我们并不声称是最大的原始骨清除分数:DES训练的传播方法比我们去除更多的肋波段能量(Sec 6.3),但是在完全解析时它们会这样做,要么失去清晰的细微细节,要么用依赖图像的注入纹理来代替它,而我们的细胞则保持接近保留目标,并进行紧密的传播。 CXR-BS,一个非扩散基线,与我们相比,曾经在JSRT上的原生256×256256\times256网格和超吸盘上得分;它在1024×10241024\times 1024的近零保留是一种解析效果,而不是方法的属性. 因此,我们与每个基线的区别不是图像层面的权衡,而是损害的概率和探测:我们的方法是唯一有统计支持的方法,在Node21和VinDr结核/质量类别上,小结核的CNR平均值增加(第6.2节),也是唯一一个在TBX11K上在探测器上击败全部放射图并在Node21上与之匹配的骨压输入(表1)。 放弃原始的切骨数字,同时声称其精度和检测结果是有意的:标准图像质量代孕在临床上并不区分什么是重要的方法,这正是我们为什么在任务层面进行评估的原因。

blocks.en: A practical consequence of the DRR route is breadth of training coverage. From roughly 5000 5000 CT volumes we generate many synthetic radiographs per volume by sweeping tube potential, view, and the randomised additive mixing weights, and we layer aggressive contrast and style augmentation on top. The bone-suppression model therefore sees a wider range of contrast, exposure, and appearance than a single-source real-radiograph training set typically spans. In practice this appears to help generalisation: the model suppresses bone on all four evaluation sources without per-dataset adaptation (Fig. 3 ). The same behaviour is what lets it serve as the decomposition operator for the translation pipeline (Sec. 3.4 ). We regard this generalisation, achieved from only a few thousand CTs, as a particularly useful property of the approach.
blocks.zh: 减少灾害风险路线的一个实际后果是培训覆盖面广。 从大约50005000 CT 卷中,我们通过扫描管的容量,视图, 和随机添加剂混合重量, 生成许多合成的射电图, 我们把强烈的对比和样式增强层层在顶部。 因此,骨压模型看到的对比、接触和外观的范围比单一来源的真光学培训通常要广泛。 在实践中,这似乎有助于概括:模型压制所有四个评价来源的骨骼,而没有按数据集进行调整(图3)。 同样的行为是允许它充当翻译管道的分解操作员(第3.4条)。 我们认为,仅从几千个国别技术中心获得的这种概括是这一方法的一个特别有用的财产。

blocks.en: Bone is structurally regular, so suppression works well even on synthetic-looking DRRs. Tasks that hinge on realistic texture (lesion, effusion, and similar findings) would benefit from images that genuinely look real, and component-wise translation supplies that realism while the additive recombination and per-component mapping leave the CT-derived labels largely valid at the population and lung-geometry level (Sec. 4.5.3 ). We are also precise about what the realism results do and do not show. FID is not the evidence for the translation stage (Sec. 4.5 ; as discussed below, FID does not track utility). Its evidence is that it is the only arm that supplies the frequency profile and lung-field detail of real radiographs, while preserving the DRR base \mathrm{DRR}_{\text{base}} ’s label-readable anatomy on the aggregate probe (AUROC-4 0.768 → 0.773 0.768\rightarrow 0.773 , with per-class shifts of up to 0.02 0.02 ) and refining its lung-field agreement with the CT. Its validation is nonetheless by proxy: these measures show that broad clinical and anatomical information is preserved, not that every small lesion is unchanged. Its target domain is model-derived, so any systematic error of the Stage-2 suppressors (the lung-component model in particular, which we validate only indirectly) propagates into what the translator learns as “real”. Downstream evaluation of translated DRRs as training data is future work.
blocks.zh: 骨骼在结构上是规律的,所以抑制即使在合成外观的DRR上也是很好的. 取决于实际纹理(血清、精液和类似结果)的任务,将受益于真正看起来真实的图像,以及按组成部分提供现实主义的翻译,而添加剂的重组和每个组件的绘图则使CT衍生的标签在人口和肺几何水平上基本有效(第4.5.3节)。 我们还确切地说明了现实主义结果能做什么,不能做什么。 FID不是翻译阶段的证据(第4.5条;如下文所述,FID不跟踪实用性)。 其证据是,它是提供真实射电图的频率剖面图和肺-场细节的唯一臂,同时保留了DRR基础\mathrm{DRRR}_{\Text{base}在聚合探测器上的可读标签解剖(AUROC-4 0.768 – 0.773 0.768\右旋0.773,每级转速高达0.02 0.02),并完善了与CT的肺-场协议. 然而,它的验证是通过代用:这些措施表明,广泛的临床和解剖信息得到保存,而不是每个小损伤都保持不变。 其目标域是模型衍生的,因此阶段二抑制器的任何系统错误(特别是肺部元件模型,我们只是间接验证)都传播到翻译者所学的"真实"中. 下游对翻译的减少灾害风险作为培训数据进行评价是今后的工作。

blocks.en: DeepDRR’s fused render carries comparable label-readable signal (Table 7 ), but this does not make Stage 1 replaceable by an existing DRR engine. First, the framework consumes components, not a fused image, and no existing engine supplies them: a bone image free of non-osseous islands, a soft-tissue image whose bone voids are filled rather than left as rib-shaped holes, and a separately rendered lung component. Stage 3’s source domain is these component projections and its target domain is real components produced by the Stage-2 suppressors (Sec. 3.4 ); a fused DRR carries no per-structure targets and would force whole-image translation, the setting whose hallucination risk motivated the component-wise design. Second, the framework’s demonstrated value (suppression models that outperform every bone-suppression baseline we evaluated on the bone-suppressed arm of TBX11K and Node21 (Table 1 )) is trained purely on the Stage-1 components. A coarse three-material split of the kind DeepDRR applies internally does not supply that supervision (Sec. 2.1 ), and the Stage-1 ablations quantify the failure concretely (Tables 9 and 9 ).
blocks.zh: DeepDRR的引信渲染带有类似的可读标签信号(表7),但这并不能使第1阶段被现有的DRR引擎所取代. 首先,框架消耗组件,而不是一个引信成像,没有现有的引擎供应这些部件:一个没有非致命岛屿的骨头成像,一个软组织成像,其骨头空隙被填充而不是留下作为肋骨形状的孔,以及一个单独的肺部成像. 第3阶段的源域是这些组件预测,其目标域是由第2阶段抑制器(Sec. 3.4)产生的真正组件;一个已安装的DRR不包含每个结构的目标,并且会迫使全图像翻译,这种设定其幻觉风险促使组件设计。 第二,这个框架的展示价值(压抑模型,它比我们在TBX11K和Node21(表1)的骨压臂上评估的每个骨压基线都好)完全是在阶段一组件上训练的。 DepedDRR这种粗细的三材料分解在内部无法提供这种监督(第2.1条),第1阶段的分解具体量化了故障(表9和表9)。

blocks.en: The realism results (Sec. 4.5 ) do not imply that these projections improve downstream models when used as augmentation, and we make no such claim. In a preliminary analysis, distributional realism (FID) did not track downstream training utility across generators. When abundant real data was available, the marginal value of synthetic data appeared governed by anatomical diversity and label quality rather than by visual realism. Selecting a generator by a realism proxy would therefore be an unreliable basis for an augmentation claim. A controlled study of when anatomy-aware DRRs genuinely help as augmentation (and of the role of label quality) is important future work.
blocks.zh: 实事求是的结果(第4.5条)并不意味着这些预测在用作扩充时会改进下游模型,我们没有提出这种主张。 在初步分析中,分配现实主义没有跟踪发电机的下游培训用途。 在可获得大量真实数据时,合成数据的边际价值似乎受解剖多样性和标签质量的支配,而不是受视觉现实主义的支配。 因此,用现实主义代用方法选择一个生成器是不可靠的增加索赔依据。 今后的重要工作是,对何时解剖学-意识减少灾害风险真正有助于增强(和标签质量的作用)进行有控制的研究。

blocks.en: DRR resolution is bounded by CT resolution. The soft-tissue component is an estimate (its bone voids are inpainted), so “exact” throughout refers to the alignment and additivity of the targets, not to physically observed bone-free intensities. The lung-component suppression model has no independent validation; it is assessed only through the realism and anatomy of the translated images whose target domain it helps define, and Stage-2 errors propagate into that domain. The comparison with released bone-suppression systems is system-level (see above): attributing the gain to the training data alone would require retraining our suppressor on threshold-based supervision. Finally, the mechanistic analyses of Sec. 6 are correlational and in part single-seed; our conclusions rest on the within-dataset analyses, chiefly the multi-seed Node21 subgroup result.
blocks.zh: 减少灾害风险的分辨率受CT决议的约束。 软问题成分是一种估计(其骨空隙被涂上),因此,“精确性”全指目标的对齐性和相加性,而不是物理观察的无骨强度。 肺部元件抑制模型没有独立的验证;它只能通过它帮助定义的目标域的翻译图像的现实主义和解剖学加以评估,阶段二的错误传播到这个域. 与释放的骨压系统进行比较是系统层面的(见上文):仅将收益归结于培训数据就要求重新培训我们的抑制器,使其接受基于门槛的监督。 最后,第6项的机械分析是相互关联的,部分是单一种子;我们的结论取决于数据集内部的分析,主要是多种子节点21分组的结果。

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: Structure suppression needs paired supervision that a radiograph cannot provide and that dual-energy subtraction provides only scarcely and imperfectly. We presented an anatomy-decomposed DRR generation framework that produces this supervision from chest CT: an artefact-controlled decomposition, per-tissue polychromatic rendering, and additive compositing yield pixel-registered per-structure projections that sum to the full radiograph, and conventional feed-forward suppression models trained only on them generalise to real radiographs. Evaluated at the task level rather than by pixel similarity, the framework improves lesion detection over full CXR in most settings on TBX11K, Node21, and VinDr-CXR, ranks first among the released bone-suppression methods in our comparison on the bone-suppressed arm of TBX11K and Node21, and, where the detector has headroom, concentrates its gains on bone-overlapped lesions. As an extension, the trained suppressors decompose real radiographs into components that make unpaired, component-wise DRR translation possible. Our DRR base \mathrm{DRR}_{\text{base}} is already as realistic as the evaluated open-source DRR engines, and the translated output leads them on distributional detail, and CT-referenced anatomical measures while preserving the label-readable anatomy of the DRR base \mathrm{DRR}_{\text{base}} . We deliberately stop short of a data-augmentation claim and leave the downstream evaluation of translated DRRs to future work.
blocks.zh: 结构抑制需要配对监督,辐射图不能提供这种监督,而双重能量减值只能提供极少和不完美的监督。 我们提出了一个解剖学分解的DRR生成框架,从胸腔CT中产生这种监督:一个动脉控制分解,每问题多色渲染,以及添加物堆肥成像素记录的每个结构的投影,总和是完整的射电图,常规的饲料前向抑制模型只培训到真实的射电图。 在任务一级,而不是以像素相似性进行评估,该框架改进了在TBX11K、Node21和VinDr-CXR等大多数环境中的完全CXR的损伤检测,在我们比较TBX11K和Node21的骨压臂时,在释放的骨压方法中位居第一,在探测器有头室的地方,将其收益集中在骨压的损伤上。 作为一种扩展,训练有素的抑制器将真实的射电图分解成组件,使得不发酵的,基于组件的DRR翻译成为可能. 我们的 DRR 碱基 \ mathrm{ DRRQText{ base} 已经和被评价的开源 DRR 引擎一样现实, 并且翻译的输出在分布细节上引导它们, CT 引用解剖措施同时保留 DRR 碱基\ mathrm{ DRRQQText{ base} 的标签可读解剖学. 我们刻意不提出数据强化要求,把对翻译的减少灾害风险的评估留给今后的工作。

blocks.en: Algorithm 4 fills the voids left in the soft-tissue density volume after bone removal, seeding them at zero density. It is a plain iterative diffusion: at every step each void voxel is replaced by the mean of its 3 × 3 × 3 3{\times}3{\times}3 neighbourhood, the known (non-void) voxels are restored to their original values, and the iteration stops when the mean absolute change over the void voxels falls below a tolerance. It runs on the density volume ρ NL \rho_{\mathrm{NL}} (after the HU-to-density transfer function, Eq. ( 3 )), so the filled values are exactly the quantity that is subsequently ray-integrated and the fill blends smoothly in the projection. Diffusing in raw HU and mapping afterwards would pass the averaged values through the nonlinear transfer function and leave residual intensity steps at the bone boundary.
blocks.zh: 算术4填充了清除骨骼后软质组织密度体积中留下的空白,以零密度播种. 这是一个简单的迭代扩散:在每个步骤上,每个空虚的氧化物被它的3×3×3 3×Times}3×times}3的邻域的平均值所取代,已知的(非真空的)氧化物被恢复到原来的值,当空虚的氧化物的平均绝对变化下降到一个容忍度以下时,重复停止. 它运行于密度容积 ^ NL\rho_{\mathrm{NL}}(在HU–密度转移函数Eq. (3)之后),因此填充值正是随后射线集成的量,填充在投影中顺利混合. 在原始HU和随后的绘图中进行疏导,将通过非线性转移函数传递平均值,并将剩余强度步骤留在骨质边界。
